summary.headline: Interrogation of a Rebel’s Defeat
summary.text: Astrological interpretation of an interrogation concerning a rebel adversary: Mercury’s retrogradation, fall, cadency, and conjunction indicate the enemy’s weakness, dispersal, loss of authority, and destruction of his plans, while Jupiter in the midheaven signifies the interrogator’s honor and attainment of a duchy. The Moon’s conjunction with cadent, retrograde Mars signifies the rebel’s repentance, subjection, and loss of honor.
